properties.title: PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989
properties.description: Crown and unformed council roads at Peelwood bounded by the Abercrombie River to the north, Mount Costigan Rd to the west, Peelwood Creek to the south, within and adjoining the properties of 457 614 Montana Rd (File Ref:15/11057, Cluster 561404)
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown and unformed council roads at Peelwood bounded by the Abercrombie River to the north, Mount Costigan Rd to the west, Peelwood Creek to the south, within and adjoining the properties of  457 614 Montana Rd (File Ref:15/11057, Cluster 561404) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to DPI - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Tiarn Farrell by email at tiarn.farrell@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 4920 5085 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown Roads at Kybeyan, east of the Kybeyan State Conservation Area, North of the Lone Pine Trail and Hains Road, West of the Wadbilla National Park and South of old Kybeyan road. Including crown roads within properties known as ?Big Hill? and ?Kybeyan?. CL 563372 File Ref 16/00665 

  • Crown road at Nimmitabel adjoining the property ?Emmaville? at 1432 Tom Groggin Road. CL 563485 File Ref 16/00729 

  • Crown roads at Shannon?s Flat within and adjoining all boundaries of the property at 35 Yaouk Road. CL 564649 File Ref 16/01484 

  • Crown roads at Michelago, south of Strike a Light River, east of Hole in Wall Creek, west of Glen Fergus Creek, north of Strike a Light fire trail. Within and adjoining Lots 7 and 42 DP 750565. CL 565306 File Ref 16/01825 

  • Crown road at Kybeyan, adjoining the southern boundary of the road at 59 The Avenue.CL 565378 File Ref 16/01849 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to DPI - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Stephen Houlahan by email at Steve.Houlahan@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3908 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Rob Roy, adjoining the following properties; 'Eglinton' at 8088 Gwydir Highway and 'Milton' at 423 Rob Roy Road (CL 564571 - File Ref: 16/01448) Case Officer: Jessica French 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to DPI - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Jessica French by email at Jessica.French@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3951 quoting file references above.

(File 16/00715 CL563434); Crown roads at Babinda, those within property known as `Ettamogah' at Peisley Road, Babinda, and those within and adjoining property at 5081 Hermidale Nymagee Road, Babinda. (File 16/01224 CL563521); Crown roads at Dubbo, those adjoining properties at 23R, 22L, 125R & 11 Oakdene Road, Dubbo. (File 16/01301 CL564400)
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads and unformed Council road at Nyngan, those within and adjoining property known as 'Tikkara' located at Rutherglen Rd Nyngan, and those adjoining and within property known as `Thornleigh' located at Neeroc Road, Nygan. (File 16/00715 CL563434) 

  • Crown roads at Babinda, those within property known as `Ettamogah' at Peisley Road,  Babinda, and those within and adjoining property at 5081 Hermidale Nymagee Road, Babinda. (File 16/01224 CL563521) 

  • Crown roads at Dubbo, those adjoining properties at 23R, 22L, 125R & 11 Oakdene Road, Dubbo. (File 16/01301 CL564400) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Margaret Attwater by email at Margaret.Attwater@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3935 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Narromine, within the area bounded by Herrings Lane, Mitchell Highway, Mungeribar Lane and Willydah Road; and east of Lot 43 DP 755132 & Lot 2 DP 47498 at 703 Mungeribar Lane (CL 569949 - File Ref: 16/06083) Case Officer: Jessica French 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Stephen Houlahan by email at Steve.Houlahan@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3908 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Gulargambone, those bound by Gulargambone Road to the south, Back Avoaca Road to the east, Warren Road to the west and Nedgera Creek to the north. Crown roads within and/or adjoining property known as 'Warrie Downs' located at 440 Gulargambone Road and those adjoining property known as `Knuckledown' located at 769 Gulargambone Road. (File 16/07886 CL572533) 

  • Crown roads at Gulargambone, those adjoining and within property known as 'Boree' located at 1397 Gulargambone road. (File 16/09157 CL574692) 

  • Crown roads at Gulargambone, those adjoining property known as `Illawarra' located at Box Ridge Road and those adjoining properties at 64, 100 & 190 Box Ridge Road. (File 16/09260 CL574907) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Cassandra Hewat by email at cassandra.hewat@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3948 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Water proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Tarcutta, within and adjacent to 1250 Humula Road ,Tarcutta. (CL 526112 Ref: 13/15750)  Case Officer: Cassandra Hewat 

  • Crown roads at Tarcutta; within and adjoining property known as "Wattle Vale" in Wattle Vale Rd - directly south and west of property at 112 Wattle Vale Rd. (File ref: 13/15878 526449)  Case Officer: Kate Unitt 

  • Crown roads at Tarcutta and Humula; within and adjoining property at 112 Wattle Vale Rd, Tarcutta, and within and adjoining the property immediately to the north 983 Carabost Rd, Humula. (File ref: 14/00677 529383)  Case Officer: Kate Unitt 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Sandigo, north of Sturt Highway, east and west of Settlers Road, and south of Paintings Bridge Road (File Ref: 17/00477, Cluster No: 578497) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Mick Barnier by email at mick.barnier@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:(02) 4925 4136 quoting file references above.

properties.description: Public roads at Gillenbah & Sandigo, within & adjoining property Buckinbong (File ref 09/10255, CLuster 576808).; Crown roads at Corobimilla, adjoining property Longview (File ref 09/15587, Cluster 577483).
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Public roads at Gillenbah & Sandigo, within & adjoining property Buckinbong (File ref 09/10255, CLuster 576808). 

  • Crown roads at Corobimilla, adjoining property Longview (File ref 09/15587, Cluster 577483). 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Caroline McNaughton by email at caroline.mcnaughton@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 4920 5012 quoting file references above.

properties.description: Crown public roads at Spring Plains adjoining the property at 1258 Sunnyside Rd (Account 580042 File Ref: 14/01366).
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown public roads at Spring Plains adjoining the property at 1258 Sunnyside Rd (Account 580042 File Ref: 14/01366). 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Lauren Tennant by email at lauren.tennant@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 4925 4129 quoting file references above.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown public roads adjoining property at 91 James Creek Road, James Creek. File:10/04806, Cluster578972, Case Officer: Rod Carey. 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Reddestone and Glen Innes, north-east of Strathbogie Road, east of Emmaville Road and adjoining Hamels Lane (File Ref: 17/01787, Cluster 580200) 

  • Crown roads at Reddestone east and west of Emmaville Road, and north of Oslo and Wests Roads (File Ref: 17/01863, Cluster 580217) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Mick Barnier by email at mick.barnier@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:(02) 4925 4136 quoting file references above.

properties.description: Crown road at Wattamolla adjoining property at 420 Wattamolla Road (File Ref.11/12854, Cluster No.581126).; Crown roads and unformed Council road at Barrengarry within and adjoining property of `The Cedars' 408 Bunkers Hill Road (File Ref.11/10543, Cluster No: 581374).; Crown road at Longreach adjoining 75 Wogamia Road and within 81 Wogamia Road and adjoining and within Lot 3 DP589582 (File Ref. 16/04830, Cluster No.581707).
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown road at Wattamolla adjoining property at 420 Wattamolla Road (File Ref.11/12854, Cluster No.581126). 

  • Crown roads and unformed Council road at Barrengarry within and adjoining property of `The Cedars' 408 Bunkers Hill Road (File Ref.11/10543, Cluster No: 581374). 

  • Crown road at Longreach adjoining 75 Wogamia Road and within 81 Wogamia Road and adjoining and within Lot 3 DP589582 (File Ref. 16/04830, Cluster No.581707). 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Brian Watkins by email at brian.watkins@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:(02) 4920 5065 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown road at South Guyra, being the lane bounded by Falconer Street, Vernon Street, Sandon Street and Cameron Street. (CL 582606 file reference 17/04557) 

  • Crown roads at Armidale, within and adjoining the properties addressed 213 and 177 Herbert Park Road and 244 and 210 Donald Road, Armidale. Crown roads are east of Donald Road and west of Herbert Park Road. (CL 582639 file reference 17/04606) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Cassandra Hewat by email at cassandra.hewat@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3948 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown and unformed Council road at Brookong, within the property 'Commera' at Commera Wilson Lane (CL 584306 - File ref: 17/05355) Case officer: Jessica French 

  • Crown roads at Urangeline and Rand, adjoining &/or within the property 'Lyamma' at Ferndale Road and within and south of Lot 2 DP 601738 west of McLellans Lane and east of Jim McDonnells Lane (CL 584452 - File ref: 17/05444) Case officer: Jessica French 

  • Crown roads at Pleasant Hills, adjoining the properties bounded by Manson Street, Edgehill Street and Crawford Street (CL 584481 - File ref: 17/05453) Case officer: Jessica French 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

In the event of closing of the road proving to be unobjectionable it is further notified that, on a date not less than fourteen (14) days after the date of notification in the Government Gazette of the closing of such roads, consideration may be given to the sale/vesting of the included area of Crown Land under the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Stephen Houlahan by email at stephen.houlahan@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3908 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown Road at Brunswick Heads, north of the property at 35 Bayside Way. CL 588738 File Ref 17/08732 

  • Crown Road at Main Arm adjoining the property at 299 Main Arm Road. CL 588957 File Ref 17/08965 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands and Forestry, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

Further, if closed, the Minister intends to sell/vest the included area of Crown Land pursuant to section 34(1) of the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Cheryl Thorley by email at Cheryl.Thorley@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3943 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Geurie, west of Mitchell Hwy and east of Geurie Creek, within and/or adjoining the property of Wondella (Cluster 589213; File ref: 17/09558) 

  • Crown Roads at Gollan, east of Yarindury State Forest, west of Cobbora Rd, south of Muronbung Rd, within and adjoining the properties of Forest View and Muronbung Park (Cluster 589408, File ref: 17/09503) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands and Forestry, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

Further, if closed, the Minister intends to sell/vest the included area of Crown Land pursuant to section 34(1) of the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Charlotte Barry by email at charlotte.barry@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 4925 4114 quoting file references above.

properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD CLOSING SECTION 35 ROADS ACT 1993 & NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CROWN LANDS SECTION 34(3) CROWN LANDS ACT 1989

In pursuance of the provisions of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given that the Minister for Lands and Forestry proposes to consider closing the public roads listed in Schedule 1.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Collector, within and/or adjoining 2812 Collector Road. Reference CL 593788 File 18/00917 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Industry - Lands and Forestry, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.  Please note that under the provisions of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, such submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the closure applicant) for consideration.

Further, if closed, the Minister intends to sell/vest the included area of Crown Land pursuant to section 34(1) of the Crown Lands Act 1989.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.crownland.nsw.gov.au or contact Mandy Ade by email at mandy.ade@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 6640 3923 quoting file references above.

In accordance with section 152D of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given of the proposed sale of the Crown public roads listed in Schedule 1. If a sale proceeds, the road(s) will cease to be a public road upon transfer of the road to freehold land in accordance with section 152H of the Act.

  • Crown roads at Bungendore, within and/or adjoining the property known as 'Broken Mill' at 200 Backrun Road; and properties at 4311 Kings Highway, 91, 173 & 293 Butmaroo Road, and 196 & 200 Backrun Road (File ref: 17/10830, Cluster: 612397)

properties.description: Crown roads at Burrell Creek, Hillville & Kundibakh, northwest of Kiwarrak State Forest and bounded by The Bucketts Way (File ref: 22/01349, Cluster: 633514)
properties.html:
PROPOSED ROAD DISPOSAL SECTION 152D ROADS ACT 1993

In accordance with section 152D of the Roads Act 1993, notice is hereby given of the proposed sale of the Crown public roads listed in Schedule 1. If a sale proceeds, the road(s) will cease to be a public road upon transfer of the road to freehold land in accordance with section 152H of the Act.

Schedule 1:

  • Crown roads at Burrell Creek, Hillville & Kundibakh, northwest of Kiwarrak State Forest and bounded by The Bucketts Way (File ref: 22/01349, Cluster: 633514) 

All interested persons are hereby invited to make submissions concerning the proposal to Department of Planning and Environment - Crown Lands, PO Box 2215, DANGAR NSW 2309 within twenty-eight (28) days of the date of this advertisement.

Any person is entitled to make submissions with respect to the sale or disposal of the road. Please note that submissions may be referred to third parties (such as council or the applicant) for consideration in accordance with the Government Information (Public Access) Act 2009.

For further enquiries please visit the website www.industry.nsw.gov.au/lands/access/roads or contact Cath Dee by email at cath.dee@crownland.nsw.gov.au or on T:02 4925 4106 quoting file references above.
